summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py, with thread-entry state (_loop, _thread_id) set and cleared in run_async. Added tests/test_concurrency.py with 8 tests; all pass when PYTHONPATH points at this repo's src. Deviation from spec: scheduling uses call_soon_threadsafe plus a done-callback that copies the task outcome onto a concurrent.futures.Future, because run_coroutine_threadsafe converts timeout exceptions on Python 3.7-3.10 and breaks exception identity. Thread state is set in run_async, so run_test does not get call_from_thread support. Other failing tests in the venv come from the missing pytest-asyncio plugin and unavailable devtools/cli dependencies, not from this change. Nothing committed.
